content.short: Vaultka is the catalyst of perpetual exchanges, providing 1-click strategies for your LP tokens.
content.description: Vaultka is a DeFi protocol serving as a driver for decentralized perpetual exchanges (Perp DEX) on Arbitrum. It offers tailor-made vaults that aim to boost returns for LPs providing liquidity to Arbitrum’s Perp DEX. These vaults have been tested for reliability and are straightforward to use, delivering a one-click experience. Their underlying smart contracts actively manage Perp DEX LP exposure by auto-hedging market risk or pursuing profit maximization within clearly defined risk controls.
